visual_differentiation_axes: luminous crystal cave console instead of plain dirt mine frame
top brass winch beam integrated with timer and swing pivot
right-side faceted tool pocket for dynamite, magnet, boost, prism, and shield tools
bottom carved order rail with crystal chips instead of generic score strip
icon uses brass claw gripping emerald crystal with cable spark and gold nugget instead of generic gold hook
forbidden_visual_reuse: do not reuse a classic hook miner icon or generic hook-on-gold composition
do not reuse ranch, farm, market, medical kit, or animal icon subjects
do not reuse dark arcade panels that hide the cave field
do not reuse tower defense lane HUD or card battle table composition
do not cover the central hook swing arc with decorative frames

ui_identity.layout_archetype: top winch beam plus central crystal cavern field, right tool pocket, and bottom carved order rail
ui_identity.hud_composition: timer and swing pivot in the top beam, coin counter near upper-left, order progress on bottom rail, tool charges in a right faceted pocket, and small pull value toast near the winch
ui_identity.navigation_model: menu opens to cave preview; gameplay stays fixed-screen; shop, help, pause, and result appear as carved stone sheets anchored outside the hook arc
ui_identity.palette_signature: deep indigo cave shadow, emerald crystal, cyan glow, warm gold, amber lantern, and magenta prism highlight
ui_identity.material_language: faceted crystal panels, brass winch hardware, rope cable, carved stone labels, lantern glow, and translucent order chips
ui_identity.typography_style: bold rounded English labels with high-contrast value numbers and compact tool captions
ui_identity.primary_ui_pack: skin_cartoon_light customized with crystal cave panels and brass tool buttons

reserved_edges: top 12 percent for winch, timer, and swing pivot
left 8 percent for coin and quota badges only
playfield_safety.frame_overlay_policy: decorative cave frames, crystal borders, and sheets must stay in reserved strips or inactive shop overlays and must never cover active targets, hook travel, or prism bend routes

forbidden_ui_elements: generic full-width bottom command strip covering targets
large modal over swing arc during active play

icon_identity.subject: split-tip brass mining hook gripping an emerald cave gem beside a nugget and cable spark
icon_identity.silhouette: diagonal cable, forked claw hook, large faceted emerald gem, nugget cluster, and tiny cable spark
icon_identity.composition: claw enters from upper-left, emerald crystal fills center, gold nugget sits lower-right, cable spark sits behind the claw, dark cave badge frames the subject
icon_identity.palette: emerald green, cyan glow, warm gold, brass yellow, deep indigo, and magenta prism accent
icon_identity.background: rounded dark crystal cave badge with subtle cyan glow and faceted stone rim
icon_identity.game_specific_motif: emerald hook pull rather than generic gold nugget mining
forbidden_icon_reuse: no cow, rabbit, medical kit, crate, flower basket, or farm produce
no plain gold hook without crystal
no dirt tunnel background without prism identity
no copied classic hook miner icon subject
